text: The purpose of this report is to obtain City Council authority for the City, as tenant, to enter into a lease extension and amending agreement (the "Lease Extension") with RioCan Holdings Inc. (the "Landlord"), with respect to approximately 43,681 square feet of office space located at Lawrence Allen Centre, 700 Lawrence Avenue West, Unit 330 (the "Leased Premises") operated by Toronto Employment and Social Services, as Lawrence Square Employment and Social Services, for Toronto Employment and Social Services' client-based program administration. Toronto Employment and Social Services has operated at the Lawrence Allen Centre since 2009, providing services to approximately 6,700 Ontario Works cases through the support of 125 staff.
